name: Rankou Konpa★ ~Shinnyuu Shain ni H na Gohoubi~
original_name: 乱交コンパ★～新入社員にHなご褒美～
source: The main character manages to get a job after a tough job search. The welcome party held at the company where he works has an orgy day to deepen your coworker rapport! It was so unexpected! Will the main character, who feels insecure as a newcomer, becomes a full-fledged member of his workplace through an erotic drinking party with his seniors and female peers?
